This document outlines the maintenance procedure P1, to be performed 
every two years as indicated by Y2 in the title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Rashad Mansour 
 Bedir, reviewed by eng. Asel Goda M.Reda, tested by eng. Mohsen Mohamed El-Ghazaly, 
 accepted by eng. Saalah Abdel-Wahab El-Wakel general director, and approved by 
 eng. Mohamed Saad Balbaa: Head Sector of Damanhour CC Power Station.

This document certified 
 by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer A and MPIS 
 coordinator.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category

Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety Helmet, safety shoes, pair of gloves 
 ... etc
Disconnect the transformer from both High & Low sides before the maintenance.
Ensure that all sides of the transformer were temporary grounded.
Ensure that you work on the disconnected transformer.

Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance procedure P1, to be performed 
every two years as indicated by Y2 in the title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Rashad Mansour 
 Bedir, reviewed by eng. Asel Goda M.Reda, tested by eng. Mohsen Mohamed El-Ghazaly, 
 accepted by eng. Saalah Abdel-Wahab El-Wakel general director, and approved by 
 eng. Mohamed Saad Balbaa: Head Sector of Damanhour CC Power Station.
This document certified 
 by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer A and MPIS 
 coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit required.
The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety Helmet, safety shoes, pair of gloves 
 ... etc
Disconnect the transformer from both High & Low sides before the maintenance.
Ensure that all sides of the transformer were temporary grounded.
Ensure that you work on the disconnected transformer.
